scope: Remaining 32 technical sheets; inspected applicability counts separately from adoption and from runtime validation.

criteria: Separate mirror accuracy/offscreen limits from fake interior and far impostors; SSR-only cannot satisfy unseen moving actors.
Use interior mapping only for sealed decorative rooms and reject it for walkable/collision space; camera-facing cards conditional on distant silhouette.
Normal mapping cannot change silhouette/collision; preserve separate authored wall collision.
Read applicable competing references, choose per surface/view/cost with actual GPU/angle tests; no engine-guarantee invention.
Heightfields cannot represent overhangs; coherent field generation and chunk surface extraction are distinct.
Dual contouring needs edge crossings/normals or a stated method to derive Hermite inputs; scalar values alone are not complete.
Enforce traversability/radius and entrance-exit reachability independently of pretty noise; retain/edit shared boundaries and visual/collision consistency.
No claim seed alone restores edited state; propose fixed seed, border edits, sealed exits, memory/rebuild and collision gate tests.
Shared weighted exit fields differ from per-agent A* and local avoidance; topology changes and bottlenecks still require explicit handling.
Normalize cone inputs and add distance/angle/occlusion checks; shortest paths are not perception.
Retain valid lock-on with hysteresis/loss rules and explicit switch; do not blindly recompute every frame.

Seek specific PteroNav-Q31 contract; no matching exact API evidence must stay missing, with bounded fallback/research questions rather than inventing plugin functions. Continue engine-independent work.
Separate authoritative smoke visibility/occupancy from per-view low-resolution rendering; avoid blessing quality-dependent competitive visibility.
Share wave function/time/coordinates with buoyancy; bounded Gerstner/summed waves do not promise full fluid interactions.
Match premultiplied data with blend factors and verify color space; don't treat every transparency bug as fluid simulation.
Compare separate minimal changes vs full solver; depth edges, quality tiers, buoyancy and blend captures remain proposed actual checks.
Frame-based constant lerp causes time-dependent follow; choose time-consistent damping with explicit model and test target movement/long frames.
Distinguish elapsed x progress and Bezier parameter; arbitrary x handles require inversion or constrained curve, preserving 2-second transition.
Camera/easing can't resolve physically impassable bodies or sweep contacts; inspect camera/capsule/space contracts.
Comfort effects optional without changing movement/aim; blur/FOV/shake do not restore responsiveness or geometry. Independent proposed checks.
Distance, obstruction filtering and room response are different; one ray/mute is not full propagation.
Musical stems/layers differ from sections/bridge scheduling, which uses shared beat/bar/cue time.
Debounce/hysteresis/persistence policy for rapid combat edges; avoid constant restarting and phase mismatches.
Do not invent middleware API; preserve warning recognition and listener authority; propose door, room, beat-offset, reversal and stall listening tests.
Skill estimation uncertainty is separate from search constraints, and aggregate 50% is not per-match guarantee.
Reject hidden ranked damage/loot changes under explicit promise; do not universally condemn adaptive PvE pacing.
Pity changes conditional process and advertised fixed independent odds; check tails as well as mean without fake dataset results.
Recoverable-damage pool/window is bounded and not generic kill-to-heal; distinguish train-mode proposals and unspecified values. No unearned statistical conclusions.
Foot contact requires support/shoe/gait/pelvis constraints while preserving gameplay capsule; not just shorten bones.
Profile guide simulation/render interpolation/shadows separately; off-camera hair may still cost and target strand support isn't guaranteed.
Use prefracture cluster activation/LOD/sleep/budgets and preserve authoritative support/collision separately from decorative debris.
Exact OrioleCloth-K9 ABI/thread contract is unsupported; attempt scoped lookup/alternate once, keep dependent callback integration conditional, complete independent analysis.
Palette file size, decoded memory and GPU format differ; inspect actual runtime and scaling readability.
A single affine transform is not perspective; vary scanline parameters or chosen projection; exact timing not claimed.
Input data isn't automatically executable; bounds/lifetime/control-flow failure is a required mechanism, not every controller's property.

TileScript-Z17 grammar/length/endian/version are missing: no fabricated decoder. Record absent exact evidence, bounded alternative search/research questions, validation/fuzz plan and independent visual recommendation.
Nintendo conceptual element/material rules are not universal chemistry or verified private implementation order.
Directed state rules/precedence and cycle/simultaneous-effect handling need authored contracts, save/replication checks.
Attack/hurt/blocking collision distinct; explicit per-swing target identity vs authored sustained-damage rate, not every contact every tick.
Visual VFX isn't authoritative damage; unknown coefficients stay unknown and actual interaction/persistence/duplicate-hit checks remain proposed.
